description: This file defines the ClearField class, a MethodOperation that clears a specified field in the environment map within the MiniLang framework of Apache OFBiz. It includes validation, execution logic to set a field to null, and a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: ClearField
classes.description: A MethodOperation that clears a specified field in the environment map.

classes.name: ClearFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ClearField from XML elements.

methods.name: ClearField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ClearField operation, validating attributes and setting up the field accessor.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the clear operation by setting the specified field in the environment map to null.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ClearField object.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClearField instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'clear-field'.
